means.example-sentence: During the last recession, even the big companies were forced to lay off thousands of workers.
means.sentence-jp: この前の不況では, 大企業でさえ何千人もの労働者を一時解雇せざるを得なかった。

cloze.maskedText: During the last recession, even the big companies were forced to ____ thousands of workers.

notes: ほかに『(悪いことなど)をやめる』の意味もあり, その場合は常に lay off ~。
lay off smoking 『タバコをやめる』(= stop smoking)。
